organization_name.rationale: Organization name is a header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule B canonical schema; it lives in the parent return header, not in IRS990ScheduleB.

employer_identification_number.rationale: EIN is a header field on the return, not a leaf element within the IRS990ScheduleB schema; no matching candidate exists in the closed list.

tax_year.rationale: Tax year is part of the return header, not a leaf element within IRS990ScheduleB; no candidate in the closed list represents it.

organization_type.rationale: Organization501cInd is one of several organization-type indicators; however, the blueprint bundles all type options into one field while the schema splits them across Organization501cInd [56], Organization501c3ExemptPFInd [54], Organization501c3TaxablePFInd [55], Organization4947a1NotPFInd [52], Organization4947a1TrtdPFInd [53], and Organization527Ind [57] — the blueprint should be refactored into separate boolean indicator fields matching each canonical element.

section_501c_subsection.rationale: The attribute @organization501cTypeTxt on Organization501cInd captures the specific 501(c) subsection number entered in the parenthetical blank.

contributors.rationale: ContributorInformationGrp [22] is the repeating group element for Part I contributor rows; the blueprint 'contributors' array maps to this group, though individual sub-fields within it would need separate mappings.

noncash_contributions.rationale: NonCashPropertyContributionGrp [46] is the repeating group element for Part II noncash property contribution rows, matching the blueprint 'noncash_contributions' array.

exclusively_religious_contributions.rationale: CharitableContributionsDetail [2] is the repeating group element for Part III exclusively religious/charitable contributions; the blueprint 'exclusively_religious_contributions' array maps to this group.
